 사진 확대 ‘Proxy CSAT’ photo | TVING Actors Bae Hyun-sung, Cha Kang-yoon and Park Yoon-ho dive into a dangerous deal revolving around the CSAT.
 The team behind TVING’s original series ‘Proxy CSAT’ released a teaser poster on the 22nd, featuring the conflicting desires and conflicts of three young people.
 ‘Proxy CSAT’ is a crime thriller about young people whose individual unmet needs and desires collide on a single day when their lives are at stake, driving them toward an irreversible crime. It follows three young people facing extreme choices amid betrayal and deception as they prepare for the CSAT, an important exam that could shape their lives.
 Director Park So-yeon, who demonstrated a deft directorial touch in ‘Pyramid Game,’ has teamed up with writer Choi Su. The cast also includes Bae Hyun-sung, Cha Kang-yoon, Park Yoon-ho, Uhm Ji-won, Park Hyuk-kwon and Baek Ji-won.
 The teaser poster shows the resolute expressions of Nam Jae-yeop (Bae Hyun-sung) and Kang Geon-tae (Cha Kang-yoon). An OMR answer sheet is superimposed over the two, who harbor different desires, heightening the tension. The tagline, ‘That day, we crossed the line,’ deepens the mystery surrounding the irreversible choices they will make.
 Bae Hyun-sung plays Nam Jae-yeop, who appears to have it all—from a wealthy family and striking looks to excellent grades—but hides a secret behind his perfect image. As he begins to stray from the life plan laid out by his father, he finds himself in an uncontrollable situation.
 Cha Kang-yoon transforms into Kang Geon-tae, a special scholarship student from a low-income background who never relinquishes the schoolwide top spot at Jeonggyeong High School, where children from wealthy families study. He accepts an unjust offer to escape poverty and gets caught up in a dangerous situation.
 Park Yoon-ho plays Joo Hee-dong, a friend who regards Kang Geon-tae as both an idol and a source of pride. He takes pride in being Kang Geon-tae’s only friend, but things change when Nam Jae-yeop’s arrival creates a rift in their friendship.
 The production team said, “‘Proxy CSAT’ adds suspense to the familiar subjects of the CSAT and college admissions, which everyone can relate to, delivering a different kind of entertainment from conventional school dramas,” adding, “The dangerous game played by three young people, each carrying their own unmet needs and desires and using one another’s weaknesses as leverage, will unfold in thrilling fashion.”
 Bae Hyun-sung, Cha Kang-yoon and Park Yoon-ho team up in ‘Proxy CSAT,’ which will be released on TVING on November 23.
 [Yang So-young, Star Today reporter]
